Team —

I validated the automation in a staging environment overnight. Key technical notes and rollback steps (high level):

- Pin semantics: pin -> sticky route selection to pinned cluster binary. For build-level pin (v2.11.7-rc3) we set the apply timestamp and ensure the control-plane rejects later builds.
- Snapshot restore: restore script will validate model checksum (sha256) and verify KMS decrypt step. If checksum mismatch or KMS failure, the script aborts and triggers fast-rollback.
- Fast-rollback path (emergency):
  1) Pause inbound LB (route-step) and drain active sessions (30s).
  2) Trigger unpin API call to route traffic back to previous stable cluster.
  3) Revert any partial model artifacts via snapshot restore into isolated namespace and fail-over.
  4) Re-enable LB once health checks are green for 2 consecutive windows.

I updated rollback-playbook.md with command examples and the automation hooks. Please review the commands under section "EmergencyUnpin->Invoke".
